scope: Read-only front-face spacing audit; no art edit or installation.
interpretation: The horizontal layout is the clearest problem. Native donor eyes were placed inward on a narrower visible recipient face; copied eye widths and thicker dark marks consume the whitespace. The vertical eye-nose-mouth distances are within the range of the checked references.
recommended_next_trial: Open horizontal space first: consider each eye outward by about 1 px and reducing each eye width about 1 px while preserving source style. Calibrate within the existing hair/face outline; do not blindly move the wider donor eyes outward until they cross the facial boundary. Keep nose/mouth and overall face/headwear size stable initially.
uncertainty: Manual reference bounds and nose/mouth centers are approximately ±1 native pixel; compare trends rather than enforce a universal numeric face ratio.
